seoTitle: How to Delete a Stubborn Blank Page in Google Docs
metaDescription: Force-delete a blank page in Google Docs that won't go away by revealing hidden formatting marks, clearing empty tables, and adjusting spacing rules.
intro: A blank page that refuses to delete is usually caused by hidden formatting elements rather than actual content. This guide covers revealing invisible paragraph marks, clearing rogue empty tables, and adjusting spacing and section break rules so you can finally clean up the layout and get your document back to its correct length.

steps.heading: Analyze the stubborn page
steps.body: Identify exactly where the extra blank page sits in your document before trying any fixes.

steps.heading: Reveal hidden formatting marks
steps.body: Activate the built-in workspace paragraph tracking view to expose invisible text characters and spacing components.

steps.heading: Clear rogue paragraph returns
steps.body: Highlight and delete extra invisible characters, empty bullet structures, or stray paragraph returns trapping the blank space.

steps.heading: Shrink oversized line spacing
steps.body: Open the custom line spacing options to reduce oversized margin boundaries that might be pushing content onto an extra page.

steps.heading: Remove hidden empty tables
steps.body: Look for single-cell table remnants at the bottom of your document that can create a permanent blank layout gap.

steps.heading: Delete uncooperative section or page breaks
steps.body: Isolate and remove Section Breaks or Page Breaks that may be forcing an unwanted extra page into your layout.

faq.question: Why won't a blank page delete no matter how many times I press backspace?
faq.answer: This usually happens because a hidden table, section break, or excessive paragraph spacing is holding the page open rather than actual visible text.

faq.question: How do I see hidden formatting marks in Google Docs?
faq.answer: Turning on the paragraph and formatting marks view reveals invisible characters like paragraph returns and spacing elements that are otherwise hidden.

faq.question: Can a table cause a page to become undeletable?
faq.answer: Yes, an empty single-cell table at the bottom of a document is a common cause of a stubborn blank page that resists normal deletion.

faq.question: Will deleting a section break affect the rest of my document?
faq.answer: It can change formatting for the section it separates, so make sure to check margins and headers after removing a section break.
